description: A coalition of coalfield residents and laid-off workers has blocked lanes on I-81 near a major interchange, demanding 'fair aid' and accusing state leaders of prioritizing Roanoke and Blacksburg. Supply convoys are backing up. Two protesters are using vehicles as barricades. Social media livestreams are framing this as a peaceful stand that 'the state will crush' - others are calling for escalation. If the blockade persists, fuel and food deliveries will miss their windows and tensions will rise at distribution sites.

The clip includes fake emergency-alert tones and a fabricated seal. Residents are panic-buying again and some are arming themselves, believing arrests are imminent. A counter-message must be fast, credible, and consistent across channels.

If the state responds too aggressively, it could trigger broader defiance; if it does nothing, critical coordination may collapse.
